purpose: Derive C2-LT-B3 source-resolution-supported issue rows into corrected, split and route-normalized source re-extraction tasks before any artifact fill.

scope.selectionRule: Include every sourceResolutionCandidate from the C2-LT-B3 source-resolution register because every issue row was marked eligible-for-corrected-source-reextraction by independent fresh review.
currentLimitations: This queue does not complete corrected source re-extraction.
This queue does not create reviewed artifacts.
This queue does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, intervention ranking, clinical-validity claims, domain-claim upgrade or individual death-date output.
Publisher-route and duplicate/split candidates must remain boundary rows unless a later independent review explicitly promotes a bounded artifact.

queueDefaults.minimumReextractionQuestion: Does the corrected source support this exact domain claim as bounded source vocabulary only, and what must remain blocked?

remainingWork: Complete bounded corrected-source re-extraction for all queued tasks.
Send corrected extraction outputs through independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact fill.
Keep publisher-route and split/duplicate rows from being counted as independent duplicate evidence.
Keep calibrated model admission, individual use and domain-claim upgrade blocked until downstream gates pass.

nonClaims: This queue does not complete corrected source re-extraction.
This queue does not create reviewed artifacts or Source Cards.
This queue does not authorize calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, clinical validity claims, individual advice or individual death-date output.
This queue only defines the next source-specific work items required after C2-LT-B3 source-resolution-supported verdicts.
